distribution.title: Wishart distribution
distribution.intro: The Wishart distribution is a distribution on positive semidefinite matrices. It generalizes the chi-squared distribution and describes sums of outer products of multivariate normal vectors.
distribution.formula: If \(Z_1,\ldots,Z_n\) are independent \(N_m(0,\Sigma)\) vectors, then \(A=\sum_{i=1}^{n} Z_i Z_i^\mathsf{T}\sim W_m(n,\Sigma)\).
distribution.properties: The mean matrix is \(E[A]=n\Sigma\). In one dimension with \(\Sigma=1\), this reduces to \(\chi^2_n\). When \(n<m\), the resulting matrix is singular.
distribution.course: The canonical correlation analysis chapter defines the Wishart distribution in its discussion of multivariate normal samples.
